**brief:** a question about a wide commit no longer fills the brief with one empty `... (hunks cut)` stub per file past the patch budget: the hunks stop there and one line counts the files left out (the file list above still names each). On a 197-file commit the commit block went from 37 449 to 17 206 bytes. A word inside an identifier (`model` in `ask_model_to_relay`) no longer shows a file of that name.
